scripts.build: yarn workspace poker-shared build && yarn workspace pokerserver build && yarn workspace poker-game build
scripts.dev: yarn workspace poker-shared build && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "yarn workspace pokerserver dev" "yarn workspace poker-game dev"
scripts.test: yarn workspace pokerserver test && yarn workspace poker-game test
scripts.start: yarn build && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "yarn workspace pokerserver start" "yarn workspace poker-game preview --host 127.0.0.1"
